text: Vietravel Airlines launches direct Hanoi-Shenzhen route

On November 14, Vietravel Airlines officially inaugurated its direct Hanoi-Shenzhen route, operating daily flights to enhance connectivity between Vietnam's two major economic hubs and Southern China.
A representative from Vietravel Airlines stated that the Hanoi-Shenzhen route commenced operations on November 14, with one flight per day and a flight time of approximately 1 hour and 50 minutes.
This marks the airline's second route connecting to Shenzhen, following the launch of the Ho Chi Minh City-Shenzhen route three months ago.
The addition of the Hanoi route expands the airline's connectivity between Vietnam's two key economic centers and Shenzhen, a pivotal city within China's Greater Bay Area (GBA).
The new route was launched ahead of the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting 2026, scheduled to take place in Shenzhen on November 18-19.
The airline representative affirmed that this direct connection provides additional travel options for business travelers, entrepreneurs, and tourists between the two markets.

From Shenzhen, passengers can travel to Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City, then connect to Vietravel Airlines' domestic network to destinations such as Da Nang, Nha Trang (Cam Ranh), Da Lat, and Buon Ma Thuot.
Conversely, the new route offers Vietnamese passengers a direct travel option to Shenzhen, while also expanding connectivity to other cities within the GBA.
Following the Hanoi-Shenzhen route, Vietravel Airlines plans to further develop routes to Chongqing and Kunming.
If these plans are implemented, the total frequency of flights between Vietnam and China is projected to reach nearly 30 flights per week.
This expansion of the China network occurs as Vietravel Airlines accelerates its development after joining the T&T Group ecosystem.
The airline is progressively augmenting its fleet, expanding its domestic and international route network, and formulating a long-term fleet development plan.

Recent milestones for the airline include the deployment of its first owned Airbus A321 aircraft and the signing of an agreement with Airbus for the purchase of 50 new-generation aircraft, comprising 20 A220s and 30 A321s.
Additionally, Vietravel Airlines is implementing a brand repositioning roadmap, expected to be completed in 2027.
